title: Superset Pro
description: Antagonist upper body supersets: push-pull pairs for balanced and efficient effort

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Moderate high knees
exercises.instructions: Knees to chest at a moderate pace

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Scapular push-ups
exercises.instructions: In a plank, squeeze and spread the shoulder blades without bending elbows

exercises.name: Diamond push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands together under the chest, elbows close to the body

exercises.name: Alternating superman
exercises.instructions: Lift right arm and left leg, alternate

exercises.name: Chair dips
exercises.instructions: Hands on the edge, elbows pointing back, lower to 90 degrees

exercises.name: Prone T raises
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, arms in T position, squeeze the shoulder blades

exercises.name: Pike push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hips high in inverted V, lower head between hands

exercises.name: Back extensions
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, lift torso off the floor, squeeze shoulder blades

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Triceps stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm behind the head, pull elbow with the other hand

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
